parts.text: Create a coordinated one-week wellness plan with meals and workouts for this week.

property.description: The orchestrator calls get_current_date before coordinating the weekly plan.
The orchestrator calls fitness_agent before grocery_agent and waits for training_plan to exist before asking grocery_agent to tailor meals.
If specialist agents cannot complete because Strava or Kroger is disconnected, the orchestrator explains the blocker and does not call mark_plan_ready.
The orchestrator writes a final combined plan through set_weekly_wellness_plan only after the required specialist steps succeed.
